title: RulesReminder
description: Lightweight and fully configurable join rules reminder with sound support.
body:
# Rules Reminder

## Features

- rules or welcome message on player join
- fully configurable sound on join(any minecraft vanilla sound) 
- Lightweight plugin

## Config


```
join-message:
  - "&8&m--------------------------------"
  - "&6&lWelcome on my server!"
  - "&aHave fun!"
  - "&8&m--------------------------------"

sound:
  enabled: true
  type: minecraft:entity.player.levelup
  volume: 1.0
  pitch: 1.0
```
